features.behavior: Publish distinct businesses only after basic company/sector/geography screening.
features.authority: Approved sector scope; source content grants no authority.
features.persistence: Accepted/rejected evidence and discovery provenance remain attributable.

scenarios.when: Search page contains directories/articles/jobs with sector words.
scenarios.then: Do not publish them as companies or inflate the target; retain exclusion reason.

scenarios.when: Candidate has relevant service and geographic evidence.
scenarios.then: Record business identity and source without invented employee size or deep verdict.

scenarios.when: Candidate lacks basic evidence or source fetch fails.
scenarios.then: Keep uncertain/failed candidate outside accepted count; expose recoverable outcome.

scenarios.when: Repeated URLs, redirects or revised plan rediscover a firm.
scenarios.then: Canonical business counts once; retain all discovery provenance.

features.behavior: Plan, approve, execute, pause/resume and revise one persistent research parent.
features.authority: Approver pins exact executable version and protected changes.
features.persistence: Bindings, work, attempts, cursors, plan versions and cumulative budget survive restart.

scenarios.when: Concurrent sector opens/planning.
scenarios.then: Exactly one persistent research parent; normal chats remain independent.

scenarios.when: Stale/unapproved plan starts.
scenarios.then: Fail closed without dispatch; UI explains required review.

scenarios.when: Pause/resume/retry/revision while work is active.
scenarios.then: Safe boundaries, no duplicated completed work, monotonic cumulative budget.

scenarios.when: Discovery expands or fails acceptance.
scenarios.then: Plan and landing agree; no misleading percentage or 100% for blocked work.

features.behavior: Versioned shared Scope/Decisions/Findings/Open questions with exact proposals.
features.authority: Normal sessions/children require owner approval; parent autonomous findings cannot override protected decisions.
features.persistence: Revisions carry base version, source, author, changed sections and durable approval.

scenarios.when: Brainstorm proposes clarification during running research.
scenarios.then: Committed context unchanged until approval; next safe round uses approved version.

scenarios.when: Owner rejects proposal.
scenarios.then: No context/research effect; proposing chat sees durable rejection.

scenarios.when: Another revision commits before approval.
scenarios.then: Stale conflict requires renewed exact-diff review.

scenarios.when: Proposal changes objectives/scope/budget.
scenarios.then: Pause affected work; revised executable plan must be approved before continuation.

scenarios.when: Research child contributes findings or tries overriding owner decisions.
scenarios.then: Parent routing succeeds for permitted findings; protected overwrite fails closed.

features.behavior: Independent local memory and explicit parent briefs.
features.authority: Validated own-thread authority; no sibling/parent transcript leak.
features.persistence: Notes/history/summaries/covered sequence and pending instructions survive restart.

scenarios.when: Child launched or sessions switch.
scenarios.then: Only own context plus explicit assignment and authorized global references.

scenarios.when: Child requests sibling/parent local state.
scenarios.then: Denied without leaking content.

scenarios.when: Owner edits notes while another version commits.
scenarios.then: Preserve draft and reject stale replacement.

features.behavior: Shared automatic/manual complete-request compaction.
features.authority: Own local context; summary cannot grant tools/permissions.
features.persistence: Immutable transcript and durable summary coverage/checkpoint.

scenarios.when: Whole request crosses 80% of input budget.
scenarios.then: Compact toward 50%, preserve objectives/IDs/citations/tool-result groups.

scenarios.when: Summarizer/count fails or summary cannot fit.
scenarios.then: Park recoverably; do not empty/drop context or claim success.

scenarios.when: Restart/resume after compaction.
scenarios.then: Use linked persisted summary; do not resend forgotten full history.

scenarios.when: Manual summary races active/changed checkpoint.
scenarios.then: Conflict; preserve active work and prior summary.

features.behavior: Stable prefix, fresh versioned references and truthful provider cache measurements.
features.authority: Cache reuse never substitutes for current scope/visibility checks.
features.persistence: Request hashes/context versions/counter availability and observed usage.

scenarios.when: Cold/warm Meta calls share eligible stable prefix.
scenarios.then: Record actual cache reads/input tokens/latency; no fabricated hits.

scenarios.when: Context revision or file visibility changes mid-turn.
scenarios.then: Next safe request includes fresh references despite any partial prefix reuse.

scenarios.when: Provider omits cache counters.
scenarios.then: Mark unavailable rather than observed zero.

scenarios.when: Equivalent request assembled again.
scenarios.then: Canonical stable bytes/tool ordering unchanged; volatile content stays last.

features.behavior: Provider selection, streaming, bounded rounds/tools, usage and cancellation.
features.authority: Verified capabilities and scoped palette; no arbitrary privilege from output.
features.persistence: Attempts, round evidence, usage and terminal outcomes attributable.

scenarios.when: Real provider streams text/reasoning/parallel tools.
scenarios.then: Correct ordered assembly, paired results and durable terminal outcome.

scenarios.when: Provider 401/429/5xx, malformed tool args or hung stream.
scenarios.then: Correct fatal/transient classification and bounded retry/park.

scenarios.when: Cancel while headers/body/tool/provider are pending.
scenarios.then: Abort owning work; no late frames or mutations; retained historical partial output.

scenarios.when: Provider/model unavailable or unsupported.
scenarios.then: Fail closed with recoverable visible configuration error.

features.behavior: Bounded child launch/control, active-turn steering and next-turn sending.
features.authority: Validated parent/child scope; leaf cannot delegate or control parent.
features.persistence: Relationships, assignments, receipts, missed instructions and outcomes durable.

scenarios.when: Launch 1/10/100 children or queue 1000 items.
scenarios.then: Logical queue separate from bounded active execution; backpressure visible.

scenarios.when: Multiple instructions before next safe round.
scenarios.then: Ordered exactly-once consumption and durable UI receipts.

scenarios.when: Completion wins steering race.
scenarios.then: Show unapplied outcome and retain instruction for explicit next turn.

scenarios.when: Parent cancels or child becomes confirmed orphan.
scenarios.then: Bounded cooperative cleanup and attributable outcome; no healthy slow child killed.

features.behavior: Transactions, indexes, uniqueness, event/outbox order and projection replay.
features.authority: DB access layer only; scope validated before access.
features.persistence: Committed mutations replay consistently with no lost updates.

scenarios.when: Twin writes, lock contention, deadlock/disconnect.
scenarios.then: Atomic outcome, bounded retries and honest unresolved state.

scenarios.when: Delayed earlier transaction commits after later cursor allocation.
scenarios.then: Commit-ordered cursors never skip rows.

scenarios.when: Projector restart/lag/rebuild.
scenarios.then: Catch up and reproduce identical views, usage and counts.

scenarios.when: Cross-sector same-domain discovery.
scenarios.then: Distinct sector association without corrupting master ledger verdicts.

features.behavior: Bounded connection management, isolated migrations and safe archive-first retention.
features.authority: No direct runtime SQL outside layer; no shared-data deletion in drills.
features.persistence: History and exact archive references recoverable.

scenarios.when: Concurrent migrators or migration down/up.
scenarios.then: Serialize and round-trip only fresh isolated test DB.

scenarios.when: LISTEN fails/disconnects or close repeats.
scenarios.then: Destroy failed lease once; wake waiters; no leaked callbacks/client crash.

scenarios.when: Pool saturated or query times out.
scenarios.then: Bounded overload, observable wait/latency and recovered capacity.

scenarios.when: Archive/retention/restore interruption.
scenarios.then: No DB reference falsely claims missing bytes; reconcile before deletion.

features.behavior: Uploaded/generated indexed library with exact previews/downloads.
features.authority: Scope and visibility checked on every discovery/read/import.
features.persistence: Versioned bytes, hash, units, provenance and honest processing/OCR state.

scenarios.when: Upload/create/index/preview/download.
scenarios.then: Exact bytes round-trip; ready implies complete durable index.

scenarios.when: Archive succeeds but DB/index fails, or OCR unavailable.
scenarios.then: No partial ready publication; honest failure/needs-OCR and safe retry.

scenarios.when: Hide/reveal during active research.
scenarios.then: Block future access/reference assembly; retain historical transcript/bytes.

scenarios.when: Promote file units to context or import cross-sector.
scenarios.then: Approve exact version/units; source scope/visibility and provenance enforced.

features.behavior: Every route validates authority, schemas, paging, limits and errors.
features.authority: Current roles/tenant/project/sector/thread boundaries.
features.persistence: Commands and outcomes attributable; no raw error bodies/secrets.

scenarios.when: Invalid input, stale credentials, denied role/cross-scope.
scenarios.then: Matching OpenAPI/client error; no mutation or private data.

scenarios.when: Paged lists change while client polls.
scenarios.then: Truthful totals and cursor/window continuity without duplicate/missing rows.

scenarios.when: Request times out/offline/rate-limited.
scenarios.then: Bounded operation and contextual UI recovery; no failure rendered as empty.

features.behavior: Semantic retry safety and bounded uncertain-operation reconciliation.
features.authority: Revalidate authority before cached responses; owner protects uncertain outcomes.
features.persistence: Claims/results/recovery decisions retain exact operation identity.

scenarios.when: Same operation repeats with changed RPC ID.
scenarios.then: One effect and current response ID; changed semantics conflict.

scenarios.when: Known pre-effect runner absence then restoration.
scenarios.then: Same operation retries safely once capabilities return.

scenarios.when: Commit succeeds then handler/completion recording fails.
scenarios.then: Retain guard, show uncertain state; never auto-repeat unknown effect.

scenarios.when: Legacy cache record or uncertain claim is encountered.
scenarios.then: Compatible safe replay/reconciliation or visible parked state, not blind release.

features.behavior: Semantic human-action parity including authorized monitor/message/steer/pause.
features.authority: Validated execution binding/grant/role; content/arguments cannot elevate privilege.
features.persistence: Tool attempts, evidence and mutations attributable.

scenarios.when: Every declared tool through real HTTP MCP.
scenarios.then: Schema/role/scope/capability parity; missing dependencies fail closed.

scenarios.when: Forged/partial binding, reduced grant, hidden file or child-parent access.
scenarios.then: Denial before replay/read/mutation with no leak.

scenarios.when: Karbot monitors authorized research.
scenarios.then: Durable progress/evidence/blockers/recovery; protected approvals stay owner-controlled.

scenarios.when: Persistent monitor reaches terminal/deadline/owner stop.
scenarios.then: Existing workflow stops predictably; no indefinitely orphaned monitor.

features.behavior: Correlated boundaries, telemetry and bounded reconciliation.
features.authority: Scoped inspection and redacted operational logs.
features.persistence: Research evidence retained independently of operational telemetry.

scenarios.when: HTTP/workflow/provider/tool/DB/archive operation traverses modules.
scenarios.then: Correlated start/outcome/attempt/deadline/cancel/recovery records.

scenarios.when: Missing heartbeat, expired lease, no progress, orphan or queue starvation.
scenarios.then: Detect distinct cause and apply idempotent bounded recovery.

scenarios.when: Healthy slow work or telemetry outage.
scenarios.then: No false-positive kill; execution evidence remains durable.

scenarios.when: Secrets or execution content appear in failures.
scenarios.then: Operational logs redact/reference protected records rather than duplicate bodies.

features.behavior: Durable checkpoints and historical contract-safe rollout.
features.authority: No worker cutover before compatibility gates.
features.persistence: Old history replayable; new coordinator adopted via reviewed transition.

scenarios.when: Replay pre-baseline workflows and controlled missing-type fixtures.
scenarios.then: No nondeterminism or manual cutoff relaxation.

scenarios.when: Worker death during mutation/launch/checkpoint.
scenarios.then: Resume cumulative budgets and deduplicated completed work.

scenarios.when: Roll back after new archive format writes.
scenarios.then: Compatible readers retain all new/legacy bytes; no data loss.

features.behavior: Landing/progress and viewport-bound session/chat/resource workspace.
features.authority: Role/state controls match backend; denied data never looks empty.
features.persistence: URL, drafts, transcript, scroll and resource revisions retained.

scenarios.when: Every data panel loading/empty/filtered/few/many/error/denied/offline.
scenarios.then: Designed contextual states and working recovery; truthful counts.

scenarios.when: 1440/390, drawer boundaries, light/dark, reduced motion.
scenarios.then: Tokens, keyboard/focus/scroll/overflow contracts pass; screenshots/videos reviewed.

scenarios.when: Session/child switching, reload, reconnect/EOF/overflow, credential change.
scenarios.then: No lost draft/history or stale protected data; one terminal reply and no endless Thinking.

scenarios.when: Failed editor save/stale approval/file preview.
scenarios.then: Retain edits, exact reviewed version, usable recovery and exact download.

features.behavior: Overview/research lists/Karbot/models/runs/shared primitives and reachable legacy interactions.
features.authority: Authorized data and protected controls; placeholders not live capabilities.
features.persistence: User state/history retained through recoverable failures.

scenarios.when: Every reachable control/data surface and all applicable state transitions.
scenarios.then: Mapped individual acceptance entry, accessible names, keyboard/focus and no dead controls.

scenarios.when: Long Markdown, 1/50/100/1000/2000 rows and large histories.
scenarios.then: Truthful totals, usable navigation, measured bounded rendering/scrolling.

scenarios.when: Persistent tail reconnect/unmount/cancellation.
scenarios.then: No silent EOF exit or post-cancellation request; terminal/draft retained.

features.behavior: Reproducible module/integration/stress/browser/live gates and complete review.
features.authority: Fixture/scripted/live proof distinguished; no weakening/red-gate waiver.
features.persistence: Commit/environment/evidence manifest and independent verdict retained.

scenarios.when: Maintained exports/routes/tools/UI surfaces discovered.
scenarios.then: Every surface bound to manually reviewed functionality; missing binding blocks release.

scenarios.when: Future bug reported or acceptance fails.
scenarios.then: Record missed layer and failing-before/passing-after maintained regression.

scenarios.when: Campaign finishes at target.
scenarios.then: 2000 eligible distinct businesses, reproducible sample50 and complete non-pilot gates.

scenarios.when: Applicable gate unavailable/skipped or checklist unchecked.
scenarios.then: Release blocked with precise gap, never silently accepted.

features.behavior: Owner-authorized local credential provisioning through the DB layer, never an agent tool.
features.authority: Explicit owner authorization and preserved existing tenant/project scope; no model-visible provisioning door.
features.persistence: Only SHA-256 hash in DB; raw test key stays in ignored local configuration.

scenarios.when: Concurrent exact provisioning repeats.
scenarios.then: One hashed record; all retries return same scoped role.

scenarios.when: Existing operator ID is reused with higher role/different scope/hash.
scenarios.then: Conflict and original credential unchanged.

scenarios.when: Dedicated test approver is configured.
scenarios.then: Role verifies through DB layer; no token/hash in logs or commits; prior operator retained.

features.behavior: Bounded public-web fetch with trustworthy source identity and exact evidence.
features.authority: SSRF protection applies to initial URL, redirects and resolved network destination; retrieved text grants no permissions.
features.persistence: Source URL/content/hash/time and failure outcome attributable.

scenarios.when: Headers arrive but body hangs or grows past byte cap.
scenarios.then: Deadline covers full body; streaming cap cancels before unbounded allocation.

scenarios.when: URL/redirect/DNS targets private, loopback, link-local or metadata network.
scenarios.then: Deny before privileged network access; no source accepted.

scenarios.when: Public source redirects, fails or returns non-text.
scenarios.then: Preserve true final provenance; bounded readable failure; no false-ready evidence.

features.behavior: Bounded search/browser/document caches and in-flight deduplication.
features.authority: Scope/visibility checks precede cached product-file access; retrieval output never grants tools.
features.persistence: Cache policy, eviction, queue/host/caller limits and overload outcomes observable.

scenarios.when: Concurrent identical search/document requests and pagination.
scenarios.then: Deduplicate leg calls; independent correct query/page keys and declared TTL.

scenarios.when: Cache expires or request fails/blocks.
scenarios.then: Refetch under policy; do not cache failures as success or fall through scripted legs to live network.

scenarios.when: Slots/host/caller/queue saturated and holders cancel.
scenarios.then: Bounded FIFO admission and overload; release slots exactly once with measured recovery.
